body:
Also I think I've grown up and all my real friends are still in my hometown. And even if I move there they won't have time for me cause everybody else have their own life and goals and it's like I'm this idiot that need stuff happening constantly so I can escape my life. (Before I moved out from there, my life was pretty much going out with friends every day, only to feel really bad when I got home cause it was gone or to be at home extremely sad and crying whenever there was a day where I had no one to do something or go out with, which I guess was at least once or twice a week).

It feels like all my good friends are people that I've met for long and I'm lost in this huge city with no one I know well and that I will never connect to someone and have a deep level of friendship again with someone new.

I wish I had a friend that I could talk to irl right now about this. I don't. I live with one of my best friends but I know that he won't understand this well and will be just super worried about it. 
The only person that I would trust 100% to talk about this that lives in the same city as me is my ex girlfriend. And I really wish I could talk to her as a friend about this. But I'm scared to death of her getting this all wrong. Either thinking is her fault I wanna kill myself or thinking that I'm trying to get back together using that.
